apps.localizedDescription:
IKEMEN Go for iOS:

Play classic M.U.G.E.N characters, stages, and screenpacks on your iOS device with native on-screen touch controls.

Features:

• Pure upstream engine — ios/engine/ is a synced copy of upstream ikemen-engine/Ikemen-GO (with only a lightweight crash-path guard and the MoltenVK config override).

• Vulkan rendering via MoltenVK — the engine's Vulkan renderer runs smoothly on Metal through MoltenVK, linked and resolved via dlsym.
• Portrait and landscape play — in landscape the fight fills the screen beneath translucent controls; in portrait the engine renders the fight in the top band and controls sit below.
• SDL2, FFmpeg, and libxmp support — robust multimedia handling for audio, background videos, and module music formats (MOD/XM/S3M/IT).
• Game controller support — MFi and GameController framework controllers work out of the box.

versions.localizedDescription:
IKEMEN Go for iOS v1.1_1.0.0:

This release bumps the port to v1.1 and updates the underlying engine to the official Ikemen GO v1.0.0 stable release.

🚀 What's New:

• Upstream Engine Update (v1.0.0): Updated ios/engine to match pure upstream Ikemen GO 1.0.0 stable.
• Vulkan Rendering via MoltenVK: Adapted the rendering pipeline to Vulkan over Metal using MoltenVK (aligning with upstream's official iOS shift to Vulkan).
• Portrait & Landscape Layouts: Added support for vertical (portrait) gameplay with a dedicated fight viewport on top and touch controls safely placed in the lower section.
• Haptic Feedback: Added tactile vibration support for on-screen touch controls (firm tap on attack buttons, subtle feedback on Start/Menu, and ticks on D-pad navigation).
• Native Crash Logs: Hard crashes (e.g. SIGSEGV/SIGABRT) now save a native backtrace directly to save/logs/native_crash.log for easier debugging.

⚠️ Known Issues & Important Notes:

• Screen Rotation in LiveContainer: Rotating the screen mid-game corrupts the Vulkan rendering viewport. If playing via LiveContainer, please enable the "Lock Orientation" option in LiveContainer's settings to force your preferred orientation before launching.
• Memory / Jetsam Limits: iOS enforces strict memory limits per app process. Loading multiple heavy custom characters or high-res stages in Tag/Simul/Turns modes can trigger iOS's Jetsam watchdog to terminate the app.
• Background problems: When the app gets to background the game dies, this is not a problem from the port, it comes from Vulkan, will look for a solution soon.

• Recommendation: Limit the number of heavy fighters per match, or use GetMoreRAM by hugeBlack to expand available system RAM.

📌 Versioning Scheme:

• 1.1_1.0.0 → Version of this iOS port repository.
• 1.1_1.0.0 → Upstream Ikemen GO engine version integrated into this build.
